preconditions.description: The number of clues n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of direct clue links m is between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.
The divisor k is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in links)
preconditions.description: Each direct link (a, b) connects two distinct clues between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of provided links is exactly m.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to add exactly T direct links to connect all clues modulo k.
